title: PR #18: fix: enforce canonical monetary policy across migrated mining components
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Verification follow-up to PR #17

PR #17 centralized issuance in `components/atc-algorithm`, but the post-merge audit found two remaining integration defects:

- `components/a-townchain/consensus/monetary_policy_binding.rs` duplicated monetary-policy constants instead of consuming the canonical crate.
- `components/a-townchain/components/mining` still contained an independent reward implementation and was not isolated from the root Cargo workspace.

This PR:
- converts the consensus binding into an adapter over `atc-algorithm`;
- connects the migrated nested mining crate to the canonical algorithm;
- preserves the nested crate as a standalone workspace because the root workspace already contains the canonical `atc-mining` package;
- carries the canonical subsidy/cap tests into the migrated mining implementation.

The monetary policy remains:
360,000,000 ATC / 360 sec target block time / 360,000-block halving / 36 epochs / 500 ATC initial subsidy / height-only issuance.
